::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8 .home-main}

I am a researcher studying the dynamical systems view of fluid turbulence. I am
primarily interested in finding special solutions of the equations of fluid
mechanics that give insight into the physical mechanisms underpinning turbulent
flows. I am currently a postdoc in [Jacob Page's group](https://www.jacob-page.com/) at the University of Edinburgh. Previously I was a PhD student with [Roman Grigoriev](https://cns.gatech.edu/~roman/) at Georgia Tech.

## Research interests

- Exact coherent structures and the dynamical systems view of turbulence
- Turbulence on spatially extended domains
- Two-dimensional turbulence, cascades and self-similarity
